description:
**Content Warning: Please be advised that this work contains explicit depictions of rape (sexual assault), violence, murder, and gang rape. Reader discretion is strongly advised.**

In the 29th century, the Divine Nation, ruled by the Prophet "Ihwa," and the Nation of Snakes, "Usa," are locked in a prolonged war.

Lee Hwan-mae, commander of the Divine Nation's most elite massacre squad, *Maerangukjuk*, discovers a prophesied future in Gwan-chang—a young officer who had quietly kept a low profile while pursuing only the righteous path. However, the future reflected in Ihwa's eyes is a living disaster, one destined to drench the entire Western continent in blood.

*“You are a black swan. A black swan that will bring an extreme shock no one could have foreseen. That is you.”*

To forge a path of survival out of certain death, Lee Hwan-mae keeps the captive Gwan-chang by his side.
First as an interpreter, then as a business partner, and gradually... as an inescapable presence.

*“So listen to me carefully, Gwan-chang.”*

One who seeks to overturn destiny, and one who is unwittingly led by that hand. The future these two write together begins to burn hotter than any prophecy.
